insight: Oily-skinned commuters constantly battle sunscreens that feel greasy or leave a heavy white cast, making daily sun protection a chore.
key_message: Get reliable sun protection that feels weightless and non-sticky, keeping your skin protected without the grease.

proof_points.text: Enjoy a light, non-oily finish that absorbs effortlessly without feeling sticky.
Experience powerful tan and sun protection with an SPF 50 PA++++ formula that leaves no white cast.
Layer it seamlessly under makeup with zero pilling and no eye irritation.

persona: Ananya, 21 — college commuter — Delhi/Kolkata, rides metro + auto daily, oily-combination skin, hates white cast in selfies, budget ₹400–600.
tone: Juicy, upbeat, skin-smart. Fruit-forward and playful but backed by actives. Short sentences. Talk like a friend who knows skincare.
